items.a: Yes. You can cancel your subscription at any time from your profile. You will keep Pro access until the end of the paid period.

items.q: Does the web subscription work on the mobile app?
items.a: Absolutely. When you buy Pro on the web, your account is automatically updated in Supabase and you will get Premium benefits immediately when you open the app.

items.q: What payment methods do you accept?
items.a: We accept all major credit and debit cards (Visa, Mastercard, AmEx) via Stripe, the world's most secure payment processor.

items.q: Is there a free trial for the Pro plan?
items.a: The free plan already includes the essential features forever. We constantly upgrade the features available in the free version.
